options.B: By cross-referencing dietary data with objective clinical markers like lab results and anthropometry
options.C: By assuming all patients lie about their eating habits
options.D: By restricting patients to a strict hospital diet

explanation: Nurses should triangulate and cross-reference dietary data with objective clinical markers such as lab values and anthropometric measurements to ensure accuracy. [learn more](GNS227_U5_T006#GNS227_U5_T006_h6)

question: What is one of the primary benefits of school feeding programs in developing settings?

options.A: Eliminating the need for any other school health service
options.B: Incentivizing school enrollment and attendance while providing balanced meals
options.C: Training students to become professional food caterers
options.D: Generating surplus income for the school board

explanation: School feeding programs serve as a crucial safety net, incentivizing enrollment and attendance while providing a balanced meal. [learn more](GNS225_U4_T3#GNS225_U4_T3_h6)

question: Which of the following is an example of a Transmission-Based Precaution category?

options.A: Standard hygiene
options.B: Airborne precautions
options.C: Routine vital sign monitoring
options.D: General nutritional assessment

explanation: Airborne precautions are a specific category of Transmission-Based Precautions used alongside Standard Precautions for specialized pathogens. [learn more](GNS122_U2_T16#GNS122_U2_T16_h4)
